    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Color zero cells that are enclosed by the line-art boundaries.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 0:
                continue
            # A cell is enclosed if 2s occur in all four cardinal directions
            # before reaching the canvas edge or another nonzero cell boundary.
            up = any(grid[rr][c] == 2 for rr in range(r-1, -1, -1))
            down = any(grid[rr][c] == 2 for rr in range(r+1, h))
            left = any(grid[r][cc] == 2 for cc in range(c-1, -1, -1))
            right = any(grid[r][cc] == 2 for cc in range(c+1, w))
            if up and down and left and right:
                out[r][c] = 8
    return out
